source_documents.title: Society Maintenance Tracker (Problem Statement)
source_documents.role: Defines required features, deliverables, and evaluation focus

source_documents.title: Assignment Submission Usage Guidelines
source_documents.role: Defines how and where the finished project must be submitted

core_entities.rule: is_important = true pins notice to top of board

functional_requirements.description: Role-based auth for resident and admin
Resident raises complaint with category, description, optional photo
Full status history visible to resident
Admin filters complaints by category, status, date
Admin updates status with timestamped, attributed history and optional note
Overdue flag when open beyond configurable threshold; surfaces at top of admin view
Admin posts notices; important ones pinned to top
Email on status change and on important notice, via any free-tier provider
Totals by status, by category, overdue count

technical_expectations: Status history with timestamp, actor, note
Notice board with pinned important notices

deliverables.description: Zip file with complete source code
README with setup guide, .env.example, API docs, DB schema
Hosted application URL (Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar)
System design write-up, max 800 words: complaint history model, overdue detection, photo handling, notification flow

submission_constraints.description: GitHub repo, branch main, public/open-source, downloadable, within GitHub size limits
Google Drive link as alternative, publicly accessible, downloadable, ideally <1GB
No node_modules, .env, build artifacts, editor-specific files
Only strictly required packages; minimal and native where possible
App runs error-free, proper structure/naming, no junk files, branch main, link publicly accessible, size within limits, documentation present

evaluation_focus: Complaint lifecycle and status history design
Photo upload and notice board design
Database schema, API design, and documentation

open_decisions.question: What backend, frontend, and database will be used?
Which free-tier email service is used?
Is the overdue threshold an env var or an admin-editable DB setting?
Does the GitHub repo submission satisfy the 'zip file' deliverable, or is a separate zip needed?
options_considered: attach zip as a GitHub Release asset

open_decisions.question: Which hosting platform is used for deployment?
